verdict.rationale: Composio is built for programmatic use. Sessions are created and tools executed from the SDK with no UI (docs-1, docs-2). The CLI gives terminals and agents a full tool surface (docs-10). `composio login --agent` signs in without a browser (docs-19), and trigger events are POSTed to your webhook (docs-9), so unattended runs are plausible. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation (e.g. env-var API key auth, CI examples), a non-interactive path for end-user app connections (Connect Links need a human click, per docs-6), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
